title: N -W F P Medical and Health Institutions Reforms Third Amendment Ordinance 2002

sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Medical and Health Institutions Reforms Third Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XXI OF 2002
NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE MEDICAL AND HEALTH INSTITUTIONS REFORMS (THIRD AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XXI OF 2002
An Ordinance
further to amend the North-West Frontier Province Medical and Health
Institutions Reforms Act, 1999
[Gazette of N.-W.F.P.,
Extraordinary, 13th June, 2002]
No. Legis.1(3)/99/4624/4694,
dated 13-6-2002.---The following Ordinance by the Governor of the
North-West Frontier Province is hereby published for general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement. ---(1) This Ordinance may be called the North-West Frontier
Province Medical and Health Institutions Reforms (Third Amendment) Ordinance,
2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.
